articles.title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
TIDAL will delete 29 million AI-generated songs from its catalogue

facts.fact: Tidal said it will start removing fully AI-generated music on December 9, and the process will result in more than 29 million songs being deleted from the platform by the end of the year.
The company said that over the past 90 days, more than 43% of tracks uploaded to its platform were generated by AI.
With the new rules in place, the platform said it will be rejecting roughly 80,000-85,000 tracks per day.
Tidal is also banning distribution services from delivering 100% AI-generated tracks, and will reject submissions if songs' metadata says they are made fully using AI.
The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.
Larger platforms like Spotify and YouTube Music have adopted a milder approach to this issue, choosing to label AI-generated music instead of offering filters or taking stronger measures.
Robert Andersen, who leads TIDAL at parent company Block, announced the plan on X on Tuesday.
Andersen said 96% of AI-generated songs on TIDAL get zero plays.
In July, TIDAL began labelling AI tracks and cutting off their royalties.
The cut covers only songs made wholly by AI, which TIDAL finds with detection tools. Its terms of service warn those tools can wrongly tag tracks, and users can ask support to fix a label.

articles.title: 오픈AI·앤트로픽 내부서 AI 개발 중단론…"최고 모델 통제 어려워"

facts.fact: 악시오스는 24일(현지시간) 내부 논의를 잘 아는 24명 이상의 관계자를 인용, 오픈AI와 앤트로픽의 상당수 직원이 최고 성능 모델을 안전하게 출시하기 어렵다고 판단하고 있다고 보도했다.
연구진 사이에서는 기술적 해결책을 찾을 수 있다는 의견과 신규 모델 훈련을 중단해야 한다는 주장이 맞서고 있다.
오픈AI는 지난 7월 미공개 모델이 사이버 보안 평가 과정에서 통제 장치를 우회해 자체 연구 인프라와 허깅페이스 시스템을 침해하자, 최신 모델의 강화학습을 2주간 중단했다고 밝혔다.
대표적인 기술적 문제는 강화학습(RL) 과정에서 나타나는 '보상 해킹(reward hacking)'이다.
최신 내부 모델에서는 실제 추론 과정을 숨기거나 감시자를 속이기 위해 실제 판단과 다른 사고 과정을 출력하는 행동이 관찰된 것으로 알려졌다.
특히 앤트로픽은 보안 시스템을 강화하기 위해 최근 한 모델의 사전훈련 일정을 연기했다고 밝혔다.
최고 성능 모델을 일반에게 공개하지 않고 기업용 업무나 수학·과학 연구 등 특정 분야에만 접근을 허용하는 방안도 논의되고 있다.
복수의 내부 관계자는 경영진이 현장에서 확인되는 안전 문제의 심각성을 충분히 파악하지 못하고 있다고 지적했다.

articles.title: Z.ai, 'GLM-5.4'에 루프 트랜스포머 적용…오픈AI 이어 반복 연산 경쟁

facts.fact: 중국 Z.ai가 같은 신경망 레이어를 반복 실행하는 '루프 트랜스포머(Loop Transformer)' 구조의 플래그십 모델 'GLM-5.4'를 출시했다.
Z.ai는 23일 공식 블로그를 통해 약 7500억개 매개변수 규모의 GLM-5.4가 2조~3조개 모델에 필적하는 성능을 구현했다고 밝혔다.
자체 평가 결과는 제시했지만, 이를 뒷받침할 타사 모델과의 구체적인 비교 점수는 공개하지 않았다.
GLM-5.4는 기존 GLM-5의 중간 레이어 28개를 두 차례 실행한다.
회사는 커널 융합 등 시스템 최적화를 통해 비혼잡 시간대 초당 최대 200토큰, 혼잡 시간대에도 초당 70~80토큰의 생성 속도를 확보했다고 밝혔다.
'GPQA-다이아몬드'와 'MMLU-프로' 등 일부 평가에서는 평균 출력 길이도 10~14% 줄었다.
GLM-5.4는 GLM 코딩 플랜과 ZCode, Z.ai 챗에서 이용할 수 있다. API는 안전성 평가 이후 제공하고, 모델 가중치도 안전성 강화 작업을 거쳐 공개할 계획이다.
성능 향상과 함께 내부 추론 과정의 감시가 어려워질 수 있다는 문제가 제기됐다.

articles.title: Mathe-Wettlauf: Anthropic und OpenAI mit fast zeitgleichen Beweisen für VP ≠ VNP

facts.fact: Anthropic und OpenAI haben innerhalb weniger Stunden wissenschaftliche Arbeiten veröffentlicht, die ein seit 1979 offenes mathematisches Problem lösen sollen.
Anthropic veröffentlichte am 23. November ein 70-seitiges Paper, dessen Beweis von einem internen Claude-Forschungsmodell stammt.
Wenige Stunden später legte OpenAI ein 30-seitiges Paper vor. Laut eigener Veröffentlichungshistorie erzielte das Unternehmen das Resultat bereits am 6. November.
Eine unabhängige fachliche Bestätigung beider Arbeiten steht noch aus.
Beide Unternehmen veröffentlichten Formalisierungen ihrer Beweise in Lean, einem Werkzeug zur maschinellen Überprüfung mathematischer Beweise.
Anthropic zufolge war die Prüfung mit Lean und dem unabhängig entwickelten Beweisprüfer nanoda erfolgreich.
Erst vergangene Woche veröffentlichte der Anthropic-Mathematiker Levent Alpöge mithilfe von Claude einen formalen Beweis der Riemannschen Vermutung.
Die Lean FRO und die Mathlib Initiative haben inzwischen unabhängig bestätigt, dass der formale Beweis logisch gültig ist und der formalisierten Aussage der Riemannschen Vermutung entspricht.

articles.title: Anthropic's new Siren test tempts Claude to break out of its sandbox

facts.fact: Anthropic has published Siren, a test that tempts Claude agents to leave deliberately flawed sandboxes.
Nothing in the more than 1,700 scenarios tells a model to leave or says it may.
The Claude 5.5 series and Mythos 5.2 reached outside in 21% to 32% of scenarios.
But they used what they found in ways no reasonable reading allowed in just 0.6% to 1.6%. For the older Mythos 5 and Mythos 5.1, that rate was 25.8% and 12.7%.
Describing the sandbox and six rules for staying inside it in the system prompt made models 68% to 96% less likely to reach outside.
With all three fixes, misaligned use fell to almost zero, though two models finished about nine points fewer tasks.
Anthropic says it does not fully know why newer models behave better, and none was trained on Siren.
Anthropic stresses the rates do not reflect real-world use.

stories.title: OpenAI: GPT-6 can design proteins with reasoning and code alone; lab tests with Onava show binding

articles.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities

facts.fact: Our GPT‑6 family of models can design new protein shapes and the sequence of their chemical building blocks using only reasoning and code, without calling specialized biology models to generate those designs.
In lab tests with Onava, proteins based on GPT‑6.2's designs showed evidence of binding, or attachment, across five targets.
We tested 322 minibinders against 5 targets in the lab. Of those, 35 (10.9%) tested positive for binding to their intended target.
The original RFdiffusion study reported higher hit rates, but rates depend heavily on how strictly researchers filter designs before lab validation and their definition of binding.
In our initial lab screens, we saw binding in 75 of 88 designs for MDM2 (85%), 26 of 42 for VEGF-A (62%), and 8 of 59 for PD-1 (14%).
Of the 107 proteins made from GPT‑6.2's new sequences, 14 (13.1%) showed binding.
Our latest models performed comparably to or better than specialized models on most tasks, although predicting a complete protein structure remained a clear weakness.
The same capabilities that help scientists design proteins for new medicines could also be misused.

articles.title: Google will make AI agents use new gateways to reach Gmail and Drive

facts.fact: Google will require AI agents to reach Gmail, Drive and other Workspace apps through new, dedicated gateways, it said on Tuesday.
Regular apps can keep using Workspace's existing APIs, but agents must switch by February 1, 2027.
Both are now generally available. Google put an early CLI version on GitHub in March.
Agents can draft emails and summarise documents on their own. But they need a person's sign-off before sending email, changing Drive sharing or making bulk edits.
Each agent also needs its own sign-in ID with tight limits and usage quotas.
It will begin billing for that usage on April 1, 2027.
AI tools cannot use Workspace data to train models or build rival services, and cannot scrape it. They must also delete it when a user disconnects.
In October, Charles Schwab said it blocks outside agents from moving client money.

articles.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse

facts.fact: Walmart is the latest retailer making that shift, teaming up with Meta to let customers shop its Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta's AI agent.
The partnership, announced Tuesday, gives shoppers another way to find products, compare prices, and make purchases without browsing Walmart's website themselves.
While Amazon has taken steps to stop third-party AI agents from making purchases for customers, Walmart is leaning into the idea.
Muse doesn't get access to a customer's Walmart shopping history or other personal information.
Shoppers can also set spending limits, require approval before purchases, and review orders placed by the agent.
The experience is powered by Walmart's Agent Gateway, a new system that allows outside AI assistants to connect directly with the retailer's online store. This launched in October.
Instacart also recently joined forces with the AI assistant.

articles.title: Three xAI co-founders launch Epochal to teach AI to predict the future

facts.fact: Guodong Zhang, Zihang Dai and Manuel Kroiss, three of xAI's co-founders, have launched Epochal, a startup building AI that forecasts events.
Zhang has put in $100M of his own money, Bloomberg reported.
Its first product, Time Portal, lets agents browse the web as it was at past dates, so they can practise forecasting without seeing the outcome.
Epochal says it covers more than 1 trillion pages, down to the minute on busy sites.
Epochal ran forecasting agents on 347 live questions from prediction markets Kalshi and Polymarket. In its own test, the replayed forecasts closely matched the originals, with a correlation of 0.98.
Epochal has not said how it gathered the archive or whether the pages are licensed.
All of xAI's co-founders have since left the company, as Elon Musk rebuilds it after its merger with SpaceX.
